name: example-threejs-cloud
description: Three.js Pong + UGC (createUGCItem / updateUGCItem / deleteUGCItem) example for Wavedash.

scripts.sync-vendor: cp node_modules/three/build/three.module.js node_modules/three/build/three.core.js web/vendor/ && cp node_modules/three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js web/vendor/addons/controls/ && cp node_modules/cannon-es/dist/cannon-es.js web/vendor/
scripts.postinstall: mkdir -p web/vendor web/vendor/addons/controls && npm run sync-vendor
